instructions.question: What overall attitude or feeling does this Facebook comment express about the COVID-19 situation, the reported numbers, or the Institute?
instructions.rule: Positive covers praise, thanks, blessings, prayers, recovery wishes and relief at good news (falling numbers, better tables), even when sarcastic-looking or mixed with mild criticism. Negative covers accusations of lying or faked numbers, insults, mockery of the admin, anger at politicians or citizens, and fear or despair over rising cases. Neutral covers name tags, bare numbers, factual questions, requests for information, neutral suggestions and jokes with no clear praise or blame.

neutral.what: Tagging friends, numbers without judgment, questions, information requests, neutral advice, humor without blame.
examples: Shkurta Mustafa 387
tash a 10 raste a 13 raste??? (now is it 10 cases or 13???)
Pse nuk i keni publiku lokacionet e sakta, si dite me pare? (Why haven't you published exact locations like the day before?)
neutral.cues: tagged names alone, a jem n'minus a n'pllus (are we minus or plus), hahaha, ku jane (where are they), duhet me na informu (you should inform us)
neutral.not_for: Questions that accuse the Institute of lying are negative; requests framed as thanks are positive.

positive.what: Approval, gratitude, religious blessings, hope, or happiness about improving figures.
examples: Falemnderit shume per punen e palodhshme (Thanks a lot for the tireless work)
Paska ra numri (The number has dropped)
Mashallah syni i keq mos na paft (Mashallah, may the evil eye not see us)
positive.cues: respekt (respect), bravo, ju lumt (well done), falemnderit/flm (thanks), Zoti na ndihmoft (God help us), inshallah, sherim te shpejt (quick recovery), perhajr (congratulations), super lajm (great news)
positive.not_for: Bare sarcastic 'hajde ma gjall' (come on, faster) cheering is neutral; prayers inside despair over deaths are negative.

negative.what: Distrust, accusations of lies or manipulated numbers, insults, mocking the admin, anger at government or people, alarm about rising cases or deaths.
examples: hajde rren hajde mos i rreni popllin (come on, liar, don't lie to the people)
+77 rrena (+77 lies)
Oh admin laje doren me FAIRY (Oh admin, wash your hand with FAIRY)
negative.cues: rren/rrena/rrejt (lie), mashtrim (deceit), spo tregoni (you're not telling), si von (so late), budall (stupid), tmer (horror), turp (shame), KEQ (bad)
negative.not_for: Thanks plus mild suggestions is positive; neutral pointing out a numeric discrepancy without accusation is neutral.
